supports.quote: I want a way to keep track of the books I've read this year.
it would be nice to see them all in one place with a short note on what I thought of each one.

framings.text: Remember which books you read during the year and what you thought of them, in one simple place.

board.outcome: A year-based list of read books, each with a short personal note, kept deliberately simple.

questions.text: Should this cover only books read in the current year, or become an ongoing record across years?

sources.text: I want a way to keep track of the books I've read this year. I usually forget what I read by december. it would be nice to see them all in one place with a short note on what I thought of each one. nothing fancy.
